articles.title: 开渔季！码头现捞现蒸的第一网海鲜有多鲜
articles.cn: 开渔后第一网海鲜今早上岸！我们直奔码头，现捞现蒸，揭开那口『鲜』到底从哪来。三步教你挑到最肥的那一只，避开注水货。
articles.en: The first catch of the fishing season is in! We headed straight to the dock for boat-to-steam freshness — and a 3-step guide to picking the plumpest catch while avoiding the watered-down stuff.

articles.title: 立秋第一锅糖炒栗子，甜到心坎里
articles.cn: 立秋的第一锅糖炒栗子来了！街头大铁锅翻炒，糖香混着热气，一个镜头拍出秋日烟火气。附超简单家庭版做法。
articles.en: First batch of sugar-roasted chestnuts for the start of autumn! That street-side wok toss, caramel aroma in the steam — one shot captures the whole cozy season. Plus a dead-simple home version.
